LightningComponentBundle.description: Node-based flow editor. A port of xyflow to Lightning Web Components: pan and zoom, draggable nodes, connectable handles, and custom node types.

property.name: fitView
property.label: Fit View On Load
property.description: Zoom and pan so every node is visible once the graph has been measured.

property.name: showControls
property.label: Show Controls
property.description: Render the zoom, fit-view and lock controls.

property.name: minZoom
property.label: Minimum Zoom Percent
property.description: Lowest zoom level, as a percentage. 50 means half size.

property.name: maxZoom
property.label: Maximum Zoom Percent
property.description: Highest zoom level, as a percentage. 200 means double size.

property.name: snapToGrid
property.label: Snap To Grid
property.description: Snap dragged nodes to the grid.
